newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM says too early to detail charges.
newsitem.headline: KLM says too early to detail charges.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines said on Tuesday it was too early to put a figure on the costs of an ambitious restructuring programme aimed at boosting operating profits by 1.5 billion guilders in three years.
"It is still too early to say with any clarity that the (restructuring) charges will amount to X or Y or Z," finance director Rob Abrahamsen told a first-half results news conference.
KLM said earlier it was launching the programme, "Focus 2000", because measures implemented since 1991 could no longer deliver further improvements in productivity and unit costs.

Asked about the timetable for implementation, KLM president Pieter Bouw said performance targets had been issued to the various operating units and that a consolidated plan of action would be put forward in January next year.
"But in the meantime those (measures) which can be implemented quickly will of course be implemented quickly," he added.
